name: model-router
description: Picks the model and the effort level for sessions and subagents with one written grid, routes subagent starts that carry no model, and measures locally how well each choice worked

fastModel.title: Fast tier model
fastModel.description: Model behind the fast tier (grid tier haiku); also runs the judge.

balancedModel.title: Balanced tier model
balancedModel.description: Model behind the balanced tier (grid tier sonnet).

deepModel.title: Deep tier model
deepModel.description: Model behind the deep tier (grid tier opus); risky work goes here.

minDowngradeConfidence.title: Confidence to downgrade
minDowngradeConfidence.description: The judge's confidence needed to lower a subagent's model or set effort low (0 to 1).

minUpgradeConfidence.title: Confidence to upgrade
minUpgradeConfidence.description: The judge's confidence needed to raise a subagent's model, or to set effort medium, high or xhigh (0 to 1).

riskThreshold.title: Risk threshold
riskThreshold.description: Above this risk (0 to 1) the start gets the deep tier and at least high effort.

timeoutMs.title: Judge time limit (ms)
timeoutMs.description: How long the judge may take; past it the start is left unchanged.

routeSubagents.title: Route subagents
routeSubagents.description: Let the router choose the model and effort of subagent starts that carry no model.

measure.title: Measure
measure.description: Record decisions, starts, signals and outcomes in the local event log under the config folder.

adapt.title: Adapt (from 0.3)
adapt.description: Choose from the quality data. Not implemented in 0.2: the loop only measures.

halfLifeDays.title: Half-life (days)
halfLifeDays.description: Quality data loses half its weight every this many days.

projectPriorStrength.title: Project prior strength (from 0.3)
projectPriorStrength.description: How many observations the user level counts for in a project's estimate. Unused in 0.2.

exploreCap.title: Exploration cap (from 0.3)
exploreCap.description: Largest share of decisions per class that may explore. Unused in 0.2.

reworkWindowMin.title: Rework window (minutes)
reworkWindowMin.description: How long after a subagent's report a redo still counts as rework.

similarityThreshold.title: Similarity threshold
similarityThreshold.description: Word overlap (0 to 1) at which two task descriptions count as the same task.
